_comment: Each run creates a new dated Google Sheet inside the shared Drive folder below, via create_file with contentMimeType text/csv (converts to a native Sheet) and parentId = driveFolderId. CometChat's Workspace blocks anonymous Apps Script web apps, so we don't append in place. If create_file is unavailable, fall back to a local decay-report.csv.
dataFreshnessNote: GSC data via Ahrefs can lag several months; auto-detect the latest available month and label the report 'as of <month>'.
